description: Bjolablum wears a floor-length dark blue fitted wool gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length outer sleeves and gold geometric woven trim around the neck, front, waist, sleeves and hem. Cream linen sleeves and a cream central underskirt panel show beneath it. Two round metal brooches sit at the upper bodice corners; a round buckle fastens a decorated belt with a long hanging end. An olive-brown patterned fringed shawl rests along her forearms, and a small round pendant hangs at her neck. Brown leather shoes show below the skirt. Her hair is gathered back and her head is uncovered.
